commit_message:
[LLVMGPU] Fall back to scalar lowering for tiny attention shapes (#24239)

The attention `VectorDistribute` configs (both the MMA-intrinsic path
and the memory-bound reduction path) assume head dimensions and K2 reach
a certain size. For shapes below that threshold (e.g. Q=K=V=[2,2,2,2]
f16), the reduction path still succeeds at emitting a `VectorDistribute`
config, but the tile sizes it picks produce vector ops whose shapes the
layout engine cannot support, causing the failure in
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24221

Add early bailouts for the shapes that cannot be tiled cleanly.

commit_message:
compiler/plugins/input/TOSA: fix: TOSA arith lowering must handle apply scale introduced by linalg lowering (#24121)

TOSA to linalg lowering may (re-)introduce some additional TOSA
operations as not all TOSA operations can be lowering to linalg. These
need a following run of TOSA to arith lowering for element wise
operations. The current pass pipeline is missing the option to enable
lowering of tosa.apply_scale, which may be introduced during the
lowering to linalg. This causes errors in the later stage of the
compilation flow such as vectorization.

TOSA to linalg lowering may (re-)introduce some additional TOSA
operations as not all TOSA operations can be lowering to linalg. These
need a following run of TOSA to arith lowering for element wise
operations. The current pass pipeline is missing the option to enable
lowering of tosa.apply_scale, which may be introduced during the
lowering to linalg. This causes errors in the later stage of the
compilation flow such as vectorization.

Signed-off-by: Florian Walbroel <walbroel@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Codegen] NFC: Lift InnerTiledOp lower & drop-unit-dim patterns to Codegen. (#24351)

Moves the two `iree_codegen.inner_tiled` rewrite patterns and their
populate functions out of `Codegen/Dialect/GPU/Transforms/` into
`Codegen/Dialect/Codegen/Transforms/LowerInnerTiled.cpp`:

- `LowerInnerTiledPattern` (replaces an iter-bound-empty `inner_tiled`
with the per-intrinsic ops emitted by its kind's
`buildUnderlyingOperations`)
- `DropInnerTiledUnitDimsPattern` (folds unit iteration bounds and pulls
the corresponding extract/broadcast pairs out of the loop)

Both patterns operate on `IREE::Codegen::InnerTiledOp` and dispatch
through the kind's interface, so there is nothing GPU-specific about
them. Lifting them lets CPU pass authors share the same lowering logic
without a `Codegen/Dialect/GPU/...` include.

Renames the populate functions accordingly:

- `IREE::GPU::populateIREEGPULowerInnerTiledPatterns` ->
`IREE::Codegen::populateLowerInnerTiledPatterns`
- `IREE::GPU::populateIREEGPUDropUnitDimsPatterns` ->
`IREE::Codegen::populateDropInnerTiledUnitDimsPatterns`

The `kShapeCastToIntrinsic` / `kShapeCastFromIntrinsic` and
`kDropUnitDims` / `kAddUnitDims` HoistableConversionOp tag constants
move with the patterns. The remaining tag pair on the GPU side
(`kUnrollAccDistribute` / `kUnrollAccReassemble`) stays in
`Codegen/Dialect/GPU/Transforms/Transforms.cpp` since it's still only
used by the GPU unroll path.

Updates the existing in-tree callers in `LowerIREEGPUOps.cpp`,
`IREEGPUExtensions.cpp`, and `UnrollToIntrinsics.cpp`, and adjusts
BUILD.bazel/CMakeLists.txt deps so GPU's transform libraries depend on
`IREECodegenTransforms`.

Strict NFC; no functional or behavioral change.

Progress towards #24323

Ops like `iree_linalg_ext.scatter` and `tensor.insert_slice` only write
a subset of their `outs`/`dest`; their iteration space does not cover
the init (the indexing map is null, or the operand has no mapping into
the affine iteration space). A producer that materializes a full-tensor
write has no shared iteration space with such a consumer and therefore
cannot be tile-fused with it.

Block these clones in `getCloneableOps`:
- `isUnfusableInit` identifies init operands that producers cannot be
fused through: `tensor.insert_slice.dest` and any
`LinalgFusionOpInterface` DPS init whose indexing map is null (e.g.
scatter's `original`).
- `collectUnfusableInitSources` uses `getBackwardSlice` to walk from
each such init through cloneable chains, recording only producers that
need to be materialized. Views/reshapes (`tensor.extract_slice`,
`tensor.empty`, `tensor.expand_shape`, `tensor.collapse_shape`) are
traversed but not blocked, so the llama scatter-on-extracted-slice
pattern still fuses.

Fixes iree-org/iree#24071.

commit_message:
[Codegen] Fix iree-compile --debug crash on CPU/GPU codegen pass options (#24190)

Using CPUCodegenOptions / GPUCodegenOptions as MLIR pass options crashes
with `--debug` (or any pass-pipeline print path): the default
`llvm::cl::parser<T>` inherits `generic_parser_base`, so MLIR's
OptionParser alias resolves to `GenericOptionParser<T>`, whose
findArgStrForValue hits `llvm_unreachable("unknown data value for
option")` on struct-typed values
([mlir/include/mlir/Pass/PassOptions.h](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/99457c368586b1debf49f55b3a0684317f5f298d/mlir/include/mlir/Pass/PassOptions.h#L158-L170)).

Fix by specializing `llvm::cl::parser<T>` to inherit `basic_parser<T>`
instead, and providing `operator<<` in the type's associated namespace
(`mlir::iree_compiler`) so ADL can find it. This routes printing through
`printOptionValue / has_stream_operator`, which accepts our streaming
that prints `opaque`. The parse path is also a no-op — these options
never flow in from pass pipeline strings.

Fixes https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/24074

commit_message:
[Codegen] NFC: Lift InnerTiledOp unroll pattern to Codegen. (#24357)

Follow-up to the previous NFC, moving the third (and last)
`iree_codegen.inner_tiled` rewrite pattern out of
`Codegen/Dialect/GPU/Transforms/`:

- `UnrollInnerTiledPattern` (unrolls along iter dimensions until each
intrinsic invocation has a unit iter shape)

The pattern itself is dialect-neutral; only the convenience no-args
populate function applied a default config (matmul-like LHS-reuse
traversal order, unit native shape) that happens to be a good fit for
any architecture, including CPU.

Renames the populate functions:

- `IREE::GPU::populateIREEGPUVectorUnrollPatterns` (with-options form)
-> `IREE::Codegen::populateUnrollInnerTiledPatterns`
- `IREE::GPU::populateIREEGPUVectorUnrollPatterns` (no-args form) ->
`IREE::Codegen::populateUnrollInnerTiledPatterns`

`matmulLikeUnrollOrder` (its content is dialect-neutral). The
`kUnrollAccDistribute` / `kUnrollAccReassemble` HoistableConversionOp
tag constants move with the pattern.

Updates the in-tree callers in `IREEGPUExtensions.cpp` and
`UnrollToIntrinsics.cpp`, and adjusts BUILD.bazel/CMakeLists.txt deps.

Strict NFC; no functional or behavioral change.
